def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    clues = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 8)]
    r0 = min(r for r, c, v in clues)
    c0 = min(c for r, c, v in clues)
    r1 = max(r for r, c, v in clues)
    c1 = max(c for r, c, v in clues)
    n = r1 - r0 + 1
    assert n == c1 - c0 + 1
    pattern = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
    for r, c, v in clues:
        pattern[r-r0][c-c0] = v
    rotated = [[pattern[n-1-c][r] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]

    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 8]
    ar, br = min(r for r,c in cells), max(r for r,c in cells)
    ac, bc = min(c for r,c in cells), max(c for r,c in cells)
    unit = (br-ar+1)//n
    assert unit*n == br-ar+1 and unit*n == bc-ac+1
    mask = [[False]*n for _ in range(n)]
    for r,c in cells:
        mask[(r-ar)//unit][(c-ac)//unit] = True

    # Expand each rotated clue color across contiguous blank cells of its row,
    # but only into the silhouette's occupied tiles.
    labels = [row[:] for row in rotated]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            if mask[i][j] and labels[i][j] == 0:
                candidates = [(abs(k-j), k) for k in range(n) if labels[i][k] != 0]
                if candidates:
                    _, k = min(candidates)
                    labels[i][j] = labels[i][k]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in cells:
        out[r][c] = labels[(r-ar)//unit][(c-ac)//unit]
    return out
